questions.q: Which element category does Subflow belong to in Flow Builder's Add Element panel?
options: Logic
Data
Transform
Interaction
questions.explain: Subflow sits in the Interaction category alongside Screen and Action.

questions.q: What does a Subflow element's Referenced Flow field do?
options: Names the specific flow that this element calls
Sets the parent flow's own API name
Chooses which object triggers the parent flow
Schedules when the subflow runs
questions.explain: Referenced Flow is how a Subflow element identifies which other flow — the child flow — it should call and wait for.

questions.q: What does a Subflow element's Set Input Values section let you do?
options: Delete variables from the child flow
Map values from the parent flow into the referenced (child) flow's input variables
Rename the child flow
Schedule the child flow to run later
questions.explain: Set Input Values passes data from the parent flow into the child flow's variables that are marked available for input.

questions.q: What must be true of a variable in the referenced (child) flow before a parent flow's Subflow element can set its value?
options: It must be a collection variable
It must have a default value
It must be marked Available for input in the child flow's resource settings
It must be renamed to match the parent flow's variable
questions.explain: A variable's Availability Outside the Flow setting (Available for input) is what exposes it to a calling Subflow element.

questions.q: What's the main reason to build a subflow instead of repeating the same steps in every flow that needs them?
options: Subflows run faster than any other element
Reuse — build the logic once and call it from multiple parent flows, so there's one place to fix it later
Subflows are required before a flow can be activated
Subflows bypass governor limits entirely
questions.explain: Building shared logic once as its own flow and calling it as a subflow avoids duplicating the same steps across multiple parent flows.
